notes:
POC -> procurement path. Started on Hosted API to validate accuracy and integration (fast SDK onboarding). After 3 weeks they flagged cost and consistent latency under sustained load as blockers. SE recommended Dedicated to meet cost and i/o SLOs. Key points from calls:
- "We need predictable spend for our roadmap and single-digit P95 latency across US+EU users" — Head of Product (Maya Hsu).
- Primary workloads: embeddings for similarity search (multi-tenant index), reranking for search results, and chat-style support assistant for premium customers.
- Target perf: P95 generation latency <= 150ms for short rerank calls; sustained throughput target ~120 qps for embeddings pipeline during peak.
- Cost/packaging ask: commit levels that allow a phased ramp (month 1 = 25% commit, month 3 = 60%, month 6 = full), explicit burst capacity for seasonal spikes, and clear overage pricing (prefer per-minute granularity).
- Proposed Dedicated term in proposal v2: baseline commit = 4 GPU units (A10G-equivalent), burst pool = 2 GPU units with 30-min sliding window, overage rate = 1.6x committed unit price. Customer pushing for 1.3x cap and 5-minute burst window for operational tolerance.
- Security: require SSO/SAML integration, KMS-based envelope encryption, SOC2 attestation, audit logs forwarded to their Splunk. Also needs Data Residency for EU users (we proposed EU-only model variant for region routing).
- Legal/Procurement: want a 12-month contract with 90-day ramp and termination exit clause tied to SLA misses. Finance requests invoice tiers and payment net-45.
- Internal stakeholders: CTO (Elliot Ramos), Head of Product (Maya Hsu), Engineering lead (Luis Ortega) — Luis is primary SRE contact for VPC peering and network tests.
Stubs/refs: drive.redwood/pricing/stormcliff-dedicated-proposal-v2, INF-3421 (se performance ticket), SEC-879 (security rollup). Next actions: Jordan to update proposal with alternative burst options (5m vs 30m) and capped overage scenarios; Priya to run one more 24h perf run on Dedicated beta env to validate KV cache warmup. Decision timeline: customer aim to sign by 2026-04-15 if legal term acceptable.
